从地图搜索框输入名称、英文或简称，也可以直接点击地图标记。打开地点详情后查看步行: Search by Chinese name, English name or abbreviation, or tap a pin. Open a place to see an example walking route. You can change either endpoint and view illustrations alongside the steps. Bookmarks and history are stored on your device. The map is a campus overview. Distances and steps are examples, and GPS is pending.
